# PhotoSwipe 5.4.4

MIT licensed, Dmytro Semenov. Source: https://github.com/dimsemenov/PhotoSwipe/tree/v5.4.4

Files come from the official npm package `photoswipe@5.4.4`. JavaScript and license are unchanged; CSS has trailing whitespace removed only. Both runtime files are served locally and cached for offline use. Package integrity: `sha512-WNFHoKrkZNnvFFhbHL93WDkW3ifwVOXSW3w1UuZZelSmgXpIGiZSNlZJq37rR8YejqME2rHs9EhH9ZvlvFH2NA==`.

This provides image fit, mouse/keyboard controls, touch pinch/double-tap and panning. Site-specific layout, focus restoration and browser history integration are maintained in `notes.template.html`.
